data.name: Arch Rogue
data.detailed_description:
The Gate is open. Ten depths will make you earn it.


Arch Rogue is (yet another) modern take on the classic Rogue formula: a grim,
replayable isometric action-RPG dungeon crawler. Every run builds a new
dungeon — new floors, new enemies, new treasure, new dilemmas — and every
death is final. What carries forward is what you've learned, what you've
discovered, and the options your past runs have unlocked.

A dungeon with intent

  • Ten procedurally built depths with themed biomes, chokepoints, traps,
    secrets, and dark floors lit only by your lantern.
  • Floor plans pace the whole run: escalating threat, elite packs, ruin
    ambushes, treasure vaults, and optional challenge rooms for those who ask
    for trouble.
  • Five bosses bar the way — the Ash Gallows Knight, the Mycelial Matron,
    the Rime Chanter of the Ninth Bell, the Voidbound Rune Sentinel — and, at
    the bottom, the Dread Gate Tyrant.

Fight in real time, die in real time

  • Melee arcs, ranged bolts, arc novas, and a dash — governed by stamina,
    mana, and cooldowns, against enemies with readable telegraphs.
  • Elites with named modifiers, Oathbound minibosses, and encounter design
    that makes every room a decision.

Loot worth dying for

  • Five archetypes — Warden, Rogue, Arcanist, Acolyte, Ranger — with active
    abilities, passive talents, branch commitment, and combo bonuses.
  • Six rarity tiers and an ARPG-style affix vocabulary: damage types,
    resistances, lifesteal, thorns, procs, and speed.
  • Unidentified items, tempting cursed bargains, and unique relics with
    effects that bend a build around them.

The dungeon asks questions

  • A seeded dark-fantasy storyline with story guests and Aid / Bargain / Defy
    choices that echo through the run.
  • Seven shrine types, hidden caches, sealed armories, moonlit bargains, and
    lore buried where only the thorough will find it.
  • Flavor halls off the beaten path — a bar with a toast pilgrimage, a
    moonlit garden, the Hall of Unlost Echoes — each with its own rites and
    little games.

Two will descend

  • Online two-player co-op: host a run, share a 4-character code, and descend
    the same dungeon together. No accounts, no sign-up.

Built for the long haul

  • Four difficulties, from Easy to the unlockable Hell.
  • Meta-progression that opens options without removing run tension.
  • Full controller support and native Steam Deck play.
  • 39 achievements.

data.short_description: Descend ten depths of a grim, ever-changing dungeon. Real-time isometric combat, five archetypes, cursed bargains and unidentified loot, shrines, secrets, and a tyrant at the gate — alone or in two-player online co-op. Death is permanent. The dungeon never deals the same hand twice.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core, 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (Intel UHD or better)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: newer
  • Processor: Quad-core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any discrete GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12
  • Processor: Dual-core, 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (Intel UHD or better)
